lines.zh: 我抱着货箱，走得小心翼翼。
lines.en: I carry my crate and walk carefully.

lines.zh: 跟着雇主走，这是我的活儿。
lines.en: Following my employer is my job.

lines.zh: 我绕开草地上的坑，怕摔了货。
lines.en: I skirt the holes in the grass so the goods don't drop.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，我不想招来僵尸。
lines.en: I keep my steps soft; I don't want zombies drawn in.

lines.zh: 我数着铜币，边走边数。
lines.en: I count my coppers as I walk.

lines.zh: 货担压得我肩膀歪了一边。
lines.en: The load tilts my shoulder to one side.

lines.zh: 走到路口，我先看看有没有人。
lines.en: At the crossroad I check for company first.

lines.zh: 我沿着篱笆走，背后有依靠。
lines.en: I keep to the fence; it's good to have something at my back.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但东西一件不少。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but nothing goes missing.

lines.zh: 天黑之前，我得回到摊位。
lines.en: I must be back at the stall before dark.

lines.zh: 鞋底磨薄了，路还长。
lines.en: My soles are thin and the road is long.

lines.zh: 我侧身让过一头牛。
lines.en: I step aside for a cow to pass.

lines.zh: 我清点了一遍，还是那几件。
lines.en: I take stock once more; still the same few goods.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我摸着钱袋。
lines.en: Standing here, I keep a hand on my purse.

lines.zh: 没客人，我把箱子摆正。
lines.en: No customers, so I straighten the crate.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，又立刻收住。
lines.en: I yawn, then cut it short at once.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我按住箱盖。
lines.en: The wind picks up and I hold the lid down.

lines.zh: 我在想，今天能换几枚代币。
lines.en: I wonder how many tokens today will bring.

lines.zh: 背后有脚步声，我竖起耳朵。
lines.en: Footsteps behind me — I prick up my ears.

lines.zh: 没事做，我把货擦了一遍。
lines.en: Nothing to do, so I wipe the goods down.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的影子看了很久。
lines.en: I stare a long while at a shadow far off.

lines.zh: 安静是好事，我这样告诉自己。
lines.en: Quiet is good, I tell myself.

lines.zh: 客人？先让我看看你的手。
lines.en: A customer? Let me see your hands first.

lines.zh: 你要买，还是只是路过？
lines.en: Are you buying, or only passing by?

lines.zh: 看看这箱子，货色不差。
lines.en: Have a look in the crate, good stock.

lines.zh: 你腰间的钱袋鼓不鼓？
lines.en: Is that purse at your belt full?

lines.zh: 别靠太近，货在中间。
lines.en: Not too close; the goods are between us.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，又低头看箱子。
lines.en: I look up at you, then down at the crate.

lines.zh: 换东西可以，抢不行。
lines.en: Trading is fine; robbing is not.

lines.zh: 你眼神不善，我退了半步。
lines.en: Your eyes look wrong; I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 我这儿东西不多，但都实在。
lines.en: I haven't much, but it's all honest stock.

lines.zh: 要说价钱，你先把剑收起来。
lines.en: If we're talking price, put the sword away first.

lines.zh: 疼！我的货！
lines.en: Ouch! My goods!

lines.zh: 脸肿了，生意还怎么做？
lines.en: A swollen face is bad for business.

lines.zh: 这单生意亏大了。
lines.en: This deal has gone badly wrong.

lines.zh: 别打了，我可以讲价。
lines.en: Stop hitting; we can negotiate.

lines.zh: 我膝盖一软，差点跪下。
lines.en: My knees buckle; I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 血滴在箱盖上，擦不掉了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the lid and won't wipe off.

lines.zh: 我弯着腰，护住怀里的账本。
lines.en: I double over, shielding my ledger.

lines.zh: 货箱的锁扣都被震开了。
lines.en: The blow pops the latch right off my crate.

lines.zh: 我退到墙边，肩膀撞了一下。
lines.en: I retreat to the wall and hit my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我今天不该出门的。
lines.en: I shouldn't have come out today.

lines.zh: 你手里那是要换的东西吗？
lines.en: Is that what you've brought to trade?

lines.zh: 给我看一眼，我不动手。
lines.en: Let me have a look; I won't touch.

lines.zh: 这成色不错，我出个好价。
lines.en: This is good quality; I'll offer a fair price.

lines.zh: 你凑近点，我看不清标签。
lines.en: Come closer; I can't read the label.

lines.zh: 那东西值三枚代币，最多。
lines.en: That's worth three tokens, at most.

lines.zh: 我这人见了货就走不动路。
lines.en: Show me goods and my feet stop working.

lines.zh: 别急，先让我掂掂重量。
lines.en: Easy now; let me weigh it first.

lines.zh: 你这袋子鼓鼓的，我眼睛都直了。
lines.en: Your bag's bulging and my eyes go wide.

lines.zh: 换不换？我这儿有铁粒。
lines.en: Deal or not? I've got iron nuggets.

lines.zh: 我忍不住往前探了探身。
lines.en: I can't help leaning forward.

lines.zh: 当心货！别撞箱子。
lines.en: Careful of the goods! Don't hit the crate.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，我差点摔了。
lines.en: One bump and I nearly went down.

lines.zh: 别踩，我还要跟你换东西。
lines.en: Don't tread on me — I still want to trade.

lines.zh: 退开点，我这儿摆着摊。
lines.en: Back up; I've got a stall here.

lines.zh: 别挤，东西碎了就不值钱。
lines.en: Don't crowd; broken goods are worthless.

lines.zh: 我抱住箱子，往后缩了缩。
lines.en: I hug the crate and shrink back.

lines.zh: 你这么大的个子，走路看看路。
lines.en: Big as you are, watch where you walk.

lines.zh: 没事没事，货还在。
lines.en: No harm, no harm — the goods are fine.

lines.zh: 撞完就走？连句抱歉都没有。
lines.en: Bump and leave? Not even an apology.

lines.zh: 我这身板可经不起撞。
lines.en: This frame of mine can't take many knocks.

lines.zh: 我这种货色，也有人要吗？
lines.en: Would anyone want the likes of me?

lines.zh: 先谈生意，别的事慢慢说。
lines.en: Business first; other things can wait.

lines.zh: 你要是留下，我就多摆一双碗。
lines.en: If you stay, I'll set out another bowl.

lines.zh: 我这箱子底下，藏着全部家当。
lines.en: Under this crate is everything I own.

lines.zh: 我不擅长说话，只会算账。
lines.en: I'm no talker; I only know figures.

lines.zh: 两个人守摊，比我一个人强。
lines.en: Two minds at a stall beat one.

lines.zh: 我把最里面那格留给你。
lines.en: I'll keep the innermost compartment for you.

lines.zh: 夜路难走，有人作伴就好。
lines.en: Night roads are hard; company helps.

lines.zh: 别嫌我啰嗦，我算得清楚。
lines.en: Don't mind my fussing; my sums are right.

lines.zh: 这单生意，我不收你钱。
lines.en: This deal, I won't charge you.

lines.zh: 掉了？我替你捡起来。
lines.en: Dropped it? I'll pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 这枚代币滚到我脚边了。
lines.en: This token rolled right to my foot.

lines.zh: 我先擦干净，再放回箱子。
lines.en: I wipe it clean before it goes back in the crate.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西要记账。
lines.en: Found goods must go in the ledger.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时护着箱盖。
lines.en: I bend over while guarding the lid.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿能换两枚代币。
lines.en: This thing will fetch two tokens.

lines.zh: 别急，我一件一件收。
lines.en: No rush; I'll gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进最上层。
lines.en: I tuck it into the top layer.

lines.zh: 手快一点，被别人看到就麻烦了。
lines.en: Quickly, before someone else spots it.

lines.zh: 收了货，我心里才踏实。
lines.en: Only with the goods in hand do I feel settled.

lines.zh: 那人往这边来了，我数着脚步。
lines.en: That one's coming this way; I count the steps.

lines.zh: 你手往腰上摸，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand moved to your belt; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我先看你的武器，再看你的脸。
lines.en: I check your weapon before your face.

lines.zh: 有杀气，我把箱子往身后挪。
lines.en: There's killing intent; I slide the crate behind me.

lines.zh: 这位不像买主，像打劫的。
lines.en: This one isn't a buyer; he's a robber.

lines.zh: 我盯上你的手，不是你的眼。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 你退后，我们还能做买卖。
lines.en: Step back and we can still do business.

lines.zh: 这一带不太平，我得提防。
lines.en: These parts aren't safe; I must be wary.

lines.zh: 谁靠近箱子，我就盯谁。
lines.en: Whoever comes near the crate gets my eyes.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个想抢我的人。
lines.en: You're not the first to think of robbing me.

lines.zh: 我把钱袋往怀里塞紧了。
lines.en: I press the purse tighter to my chest.

lines.zh: 来了，我认得这种走路的姿势。
lines.en: Here it comes; I know that walk.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你就会动手。
lines.en: I'll count to three, then you'll strike.

lines.zh: 别怪我小气，我这行都这样。
lines.en: Don't call me stingy; it's how this trade works.

lines.zh: 你先动的手，可别后悔。
lines.en: You struck first — don't regret it.

lines.zh: 我背靠墙，箱子在脚边。
lines.en: Back to the wall, crate at my feet.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就退半步。
lines.en: Every step you take, I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我盯着你那只握剑的手。
lines.en: I fix on the hand holding that sword.

lines.zh: 这条街我熟，跑得掉。
lines.en: I know this street; I can get away.

lines.zh: 我在算，跑到巷口要几步。
lines.en: I'm counting the steps to the alley mouth.

lines.zh: 你把退路堵了，我只好站着。
lines.en: You've cut my retreat; I'll have to stand.

lines.zh: 别过来，我不想流血。
lines.en: Don't come closer; I don't want blood.

lines.zh: 我抱着箱子，指节都白了。
lines.en: I grip the crate until my knuckles go white.

lines.zh: 你要是冲，我就往人群里钻。
lines.en: If you charge, I'll slip into the crowd.

lines.zh: 商人代币，你有吗？
lines.en: Got any trader tokens?

lines.zh: 你挡住我回摊位的路。
lines.en: You are blocking my way back to the stall.

lines.zh: 这条巷子太窄，我失策了。
lines.en: This alley is too narrow; I misjudged.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣着箱扣没松。
lines.en: My fingers stay hooked on the crate clasp.

lines.zh: 我等你自己走开。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to walk away.

lines.zh: 手心全是汗，钱袋滑了。
lines.en: My palm is all sweat; the purse slips.

lines.zh: 别把我逼到墙角。
lines.en: Don't back me into the corner.

lines.zh: 我把箱子挡在身前。
lines.en: I put the crate in front of me.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我不喜欢这笑。
lines.en: What are you grinning at? I don't like it.

lines.zh: 我拿货箱挡了一下，手还麻。
lines.en: I blocked with a crate; my arm still tingles.

lines.zh: 别打脸，我还得做生意。
lines.en: Not the face; I still have to trade.

lines.zh: 我抓了把土撒你眼睛。
lines.en: I fling a fistful of dirt in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我踢了你的膝盖就退。
lines.en: I kick your knee and pull back.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的货撒了一半。
lines.en: Now half my goods are spilled.

lines.zh: 我拿秤杆敲你的手。
lines.en: I rap your hand with the scale beam.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我也会还手。
lines.en: Don't push me; I can hit back too.

lines.zh: 我一边打一边往后挪。
lines.en: I fight while shuffling backward.

lines.zh: 你砍到箱子上了，心疼死我。
lines.en: You struck the crate — that hurts me more.

lines.zh: 我护着钱袋，用肩撞你。
lines.en: Guarding my purse, I ram you with a shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一拳没什么劲，但够我跑。
lines.en: This punch won't do much, but it buys my escape.

lines.zh: 我扯着嗓子喊，边喊边打。
lines.en: I shout at the top of my lungs while swinging.

lines.zh: 打不过，我就跑，这很正常。
lines.en: If I can't win, I run — perfectly normal.

lines.zh: 别追了，货都给你一半！
lines.en: Stop chasing! You can have half the goods!

lines.zh: 我扔出一枚铜币引开你。
lines.en: I toss a copper away to draw you off.

lines.zh: 放下箱子，我跑得更快。
lines.en: Crate down, and I run much faster.

lines.zh: 商人蛋裂开，我爬了出来。
lines.en: The trader egg cracks and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 我落地第一件事，是看货齐不齐。
lines.en: First thing after landing: check the stock.

lines.zh: 有人雇了我，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone hired me, so here I am.

lines.zh: 我把摊位支在墙根下。
lines.en: I set my stall against the wall.

lines.zh: 这地方人不多，生意难做。
lines.en: Few people here; trade will be slow.

lines.zh: 我理了理领口，站得笔直。
lines.en: I straighten my collar and stand tall.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这条街有我。
lines.en: From today, this street has me.

lines.zh: 我敲了敲箱子，听声音。
lines.en: I tap the crate and listen to the sound.

lines.zh: 铺开布，摆上货，开张。
lines.en: Cloth down, goods out — we're open.

lines.zh: 我先数了三遍东西才安心。
lines.en: I counted the goods three times before I settled.

lines.zh: 风把招牌吹歪了，我扶正。
lines.en: The wind skews my sign; I set it straight.

lines.zh: 来客人了吗？我清了清嗓子。
lines.en: A customer? I clear my throat.

lines.zh: 站在摊后，我才觉得踏实。
lines.en: Only behind the stall do I feel steady.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等第一个买家。
lines.en: I'm here for the first buyer.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到箱角，我赶紧拍灭。
lines.en: Flame licks the crate corner; I slap it out.

lines.zh: 摔得我屁股疼，货还压在身上。
lines.en: My rear hurts and the crate's on top of me.

lines.zh: 我不会游泳，水灌进嘴里了。
lines.en: I can't swim; water's pouring into my mouth.

lines.zh: 炸得箱子飞了，货撒一地。
lines.en: The blast sends the crate flying; goods everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭插在箱子上，吓死我了。
lines.en: An arrow in the crate — it scared me half to death.

lines.zh: 那股魔法让我的手指发僵。
lines.en: That magic stiffens my fingers.

lines.zh: 饿着肚子算账，脑子发昏。
lines.en: Counting coins on an empty stomach makes my head swim.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我抱着箱子趴下了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby; I drop and cover the crate.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，货一件都没带。
lines.en: I fall into the void with none of my goods.
